name: hold-button

frames.best_why: Red liquid fill is halfway across the button with the label still sharp, showing the hold in progress.

tagline: Press and hold to fill it with red liquid, releasing early drains it.
summary: A confirmation button that fills with colour while you keep it pressed, then switches to a done label when the hold completes. Letting go too soon drains the fill back out.
appearance: A rounded charcoal button with a light label sits centred on a near-black rounded card, below a bold white heading and two lines of muted grey body copy. A faint caption sits on the stage below the card.
behaviour: Pressing and holding fills the button left to right with red, led by a wavy crest; holding to the end swaps the label to a done message with a soft glow and pulse. Releasing early drains the red back out.
demo_content: Delete "Q3 Launch Plan"? with a warning that 14 files and 3 shared links will be removed.
search_phrases: press and hold to confirm button
button that fills up while you hold
danger action with press and hold
use_when: A destructive action needs deliberate confirmation so an accidental click cannot delete data.
avoid_when: Requires a sustained press, so it slows frequent actions and can confuse users on touch screens.
customise: Label, done label, icons, fill/background/text colours, size, radius, hold and release times, wave and glow are all props. The wavy crest shape only changes by editing the source CSS.
weight_why: One button, a raf loop only while pressed, CSS transitions the rest of the time.

a11y.note: Space or Enter starts the hold and Escape cancels; progress is only described by a static hint, not announced as it fills.

issues: Frame 4 catches the done label mid-blur, so the success wording is never readable in the clip.
polish_why: Clean card layout and a convincing liquid fill; the done state is only caught blurred.
